$comment: The one place Chute's colours are declared. Four surfaces read this file: the app icon (Scripts/make-icon.swift), the website (brand/gen-tailwind.mjs), the terminal demos (brand/gen-vhs-theme.mjs) and the social graphics (brand/cards.py). Colour drift across four surfaces during a launch is what reads as amateur. Regenerate with `make -C brand`.
$palette: Extracted from the shipped app icon, not invented. Deep slate lit from above, with the chute's own green as the single accent. Terminal-green on slate is the colour of the thing being sold, and it is the exact opposite of the violet-to-blue gradient that marks a generated landing page.

ground600.role: hairline borders, the lit top edge

accentGlow.role: the lit slot — CTA, focus ring, ONE glow per screen

paper.role: the falling documents — light ground, body text on dark

muted.role: secondary text, never for anything load-bearing

danger.role: a destructive action, a failed check

$sessions: The 12 per-project hues from Sources/ChuteCore/SessionColor.swift, One Dark derived, chosen to stay distinguishable on both light and dark menu backgrounds. Reserved for project dots and data viz. Nothing else gets a colour.
$type: Mono headings say 'made by someone who lives in a terminal', which is the ICP. Do NOT use shadcn's default Inter/Geist + zinc — that pairing IS the templated look.
$geometry: Dev tools are sharp. 4px, not shadcn's 0.5rem.
